{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if any of them are in the target group (new + paid_search)
qa_in_target = qa_orders[(qa_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'new')]
print(f'QA orders in target group (new + paid_search): {len(qa_in_target)}')

# Check status: refunded orders should be excluded from revenue, but the question is about conversion, not revenue
# The 'converted' column is 1 if checkout completed, regardless of refund
# But we must check if refunded orders are in the target group
refunded_in_target = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['status'] == 'refunded')]
print(f'Refunded orders in target group (new + paid_search): {len(refunded_in_target)}')"}
